content:
I've been writing about this problem for a year. My team finally put numbers on it.

In this issue

  • Time Is Compounding Capital. The dollar gap matters, but the time gap might matter more.
  • Team Size Is the Quiet Part. Typical commercetools programs require 5-8 full-time developers, and that's not just for the build.
  • Who Picks What (and Why). commercetools is for teams that want to own the architecture.
  • The Blind Spot. Everything above compares two approaches that exist today.
  • The Capabilities You Can't Skip. At enterprise scale, order management and marketplace aren't nice-to-haves.
